_why: THE PRICES THE AWS EDITION OF BUNDLE D CHARGES, and nothing else.
tools/marketplace_update_offer_prices.py reads the LIVE offer, checks it against this
file, and builds ONE change set that replaces the offer's two pricing terms. It does not
touch the legal, support, renewal or targeting terms.
DECIDED 2026-10-25 by Andrew: the AWS edition scores from RelayShield's own corpus and
carries fewer tools than the Stripe-direct bundle, so it is sold at 5 to 10 percent BELOW
the Stripe-direct price. There were no AWS subscribers when this was decided, so nobody's
price moved. The bundle is the same one sold on the developers site; only the data path
and the price differ. See CLAUDE.md, the AWS-licensed first-party path section.
'reference' is the Stripe-direct price. Per-call references are read out of
relayshield_api.py's METERED_CREDIT_COSTS by test_bundle_d_aws_prices.py, so this file
cannot quietly disagree with what the code charges. 'aws' is the new AWS price.
THE BAND IS ENFORCED, NOT REMEMBERED. The tool and the test both refuse a price that is
less than 5 or more than 10 percent below its reference. $269 would be 10.03 percent, which
is why the monthly minimum is $270.
A CHANGE SET REPLACES THE WHOLE RATE CARD. On 2026-07-27 a malformed one rolled Bundle D's
prices back to placeholders. So the tool also refuses unless the live offer carries exactly
the dimensions named here, at exactly the 'reference' prices: a live card that has already
changed means this file is stale, and applying it would overwrite someone's change.
